mapper.select: WITH latest_view AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) target_id AS product_id, created_at FROM user_behavior_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND action = 'VIEW' ORDER BY target_id, created_at DESC ) SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.name, p.price, p.discount_price AS discountPrice, p.image_url AS imageUrl, lv.created_at AS viewedAt FROM latest_view lv JOIN products p ON p.product_id = lv.product_id WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY lv.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
